Name: Haley Russian Wedding Dress
Author: Elaho
Description:
[b]UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod.
[/b]
This mod replaces Haley's original wedding outfit to incorporate traditional Russian wedding regalia, including:

- Beautifully embroidered Rubakha (long shirt with puffed sleeves)
- Equally detailed Sarafan (long, trapezoidal jumper dress that goes over the Rubakha)
- Kokoshnik (traditional Russian headdress, embedded with jewels, lace, and fine details)
- Intricately detailed collar-necklace
- Various other jewels and jewellery

In this mod, Haley's family is both Russian and Ukrainian, but I decided to make her more closely connected to the Russian side of her family (which is a common feeling in a mixed-ancestry family, at least in my experience).

Haley isn't the kind of character I'd normally think of being super into family traditions, being the modern fashionista she is; but, thinking of how much she cared about losing her grandmother's bracelet, I think she would want to find some kind of meaningful connection between her family's heritage and her love of fashion. Russian traditional dresses are beautiful, ornate, and give off an aura of timelessness, and I think Haley would want to share her love of both fashion and family on her wedding day, as a beautiful Russian princess. 

[i]Поздравляю с днём вашей свадьбы! От всей души желаю семейного счастья, искреннего взаимопонимания, любви и благополучия![/i]

------------------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

[b]UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. No action needed.[/b]

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Haley. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Haley's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Haley's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*
